dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 4-6 prominent 'O' shaped light-grey rings are visible on the mid-lateral flank. These structures feature a soft gradient transition from the dark-grey base fur into a higher-intensity light-grey perimeter, often enclosing a darker-intensity central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark, asymmetrical spots is observed in the neck and shoulder region. These spots lack internal gradients and appear as localized clusters of low-intensity pixels against the lighter base fur of the anterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triad of large macro-annuli on the mid-flank forms an obtuse triangle, with the vertex pointing towards the dorsal ridge. Smaller high-intensity blobs on the lower lateral region form a linear chain roughly parallel to the ventral outline.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized area of high-intensity white-spectrum pixels is prominent on the left dorsal shoulder, appearing as a broad, bright patch that contrasts significantly with the more uniform dark-grey pigmentation of the head.
